summary: Super Group (SGHC) filed a Form 6-K furnishing its Q3 2026 results press release, disclosing Board approval of a share repurchase program of up to $150 million running through December 2027. Q3 revenue was $611 million, profit $142 million and Adjusted EBITDA $165 million; cash stood at $602 million at September 30, 2026. FY2026 guidance was revised to $2.525–2.575 billion revenue and $700–720 million Adjusted EBITDA. The buyback is open-market discretionary, with no price, premium or tender mechanics disclosed; watch execution pace and cash deployment versus the Apricot sportsbook integration.
